values.note: Free Special Use License reserved on the District's booking engine (KICCO > RV/Travel Trailer > 'Campsite - Town of KICCO (RV/Trailer)'); the gate combination is printed on the license. Up to 8 consecutive days per permit, departing on the 8th day; 30 days a year District-wide. The District's KICCO web page tags only 'Camping (Tent)', but the booking engine sells an RV/Trailer permit for this site.

booking.source: https://secure.rzda.net/sfwmd/list.cfm (KICCO, RV/Travel Trailer calendar: 'You are allowed only eight (8) consecutive days per permit and must depart on the 8th day', rows 'Campsite - Town of KICCO' and 'Campsite - Town of KICCO (RV/Trailer)') + SUL FAQ ('There is a limit of 30 days per year, District-wide'), read 2026-10-21

note: Largest of the five primitive campsites in SFWMD's KICCO Wildlife Management Area, on the Kissimmee River off River Ranch Blvd, south of SR-60 between Lake Wales and Yeehaw Junction. Open grass clearing on the old river channel; picnic tables and fire rings. Horses are also allowed here. --Claude
summary: District pages and SUL booking engine: confirmed free SUL reservation, no hookups, 8-day permit limit; the booking engine sells 'Campsite - Town of KICCO (RV/Trailer)', settling the note's tent-only doubt (the FAQ's 'no length limit' for RVs/travel trailers still stands). No storm closure posted for KICCO (the SUL page only says 'Some lands may have campgrounds and interior vehicles access roads that are temporarily closed'). Note trimmed of the fee/limit/hookup facts the fields carry. Not stated: season, toilets.
flags: The District's KICCO page lists only 'Camping (Tent)' among activities, while the booking engine and the 2020 SUL FAQ list RV/travel-trailer camping at the Town of KICCO Campsite ('There is no length limit'). No 4WD statement found; access is through a locked gate (combination on the license).
